scientific_integrity: Analytic proof establishes all-order inequalities; 4,661 finite checker assertions and diagnostics test specific instances but do not replace infinite proofs. Previously established greedy policy and single-collector asymptotics are not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite graphs; independent uniform neighbor offers with replacement; synchronous two-choice vertex cover. The source advantage is at most one step, exactly one at the star boundary K_{a,1} for a>1; the logistic window requires both part sizes to diverge with difference of order n/log n. No wider graph-family or alternative sampling guarantee. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: All-deadline source ordering and a logistic crossover for two-choice biclique coverage
